name: Zeke
description: Everything is 3D! A perspective floor with a vanishing point. Move forward = go deep into the screen (smaller). Move back = come toward you (bigger). Enemies and bullets all scale with depth!

name: Gabi
description: Enemies are real 3D cubes — front face, bright top, dark sides. Press X (or Z on keyboard) to JUMP! While airborne the Maker floats over enemies harmlessly. Shadow on the ground shows your height!
